name: Xiaohe fermented dairy remains
description: Dairy remains in Xiaohe cemetery burials were identified by researchers as fermented cheese.

impact.note: Cheese remains in one cemetery, long after dairying began elsewhere; a witness of an existing practice.

date.label: Approximately 3,500 years ago
date.basis: Date applies to the stated documented event or archaeological context, not to a worldwide origin.

events.statement: Dairy remains in Xiaohe cemetery burials were identified by researchers as fermented cheese.

evidence.supports: A study identifies three approximately 3,500-year-old dairy remains from the Xiaohe cemetery as fermented cheese. Identification and context are archaeological; the burial samples do not establish ordinary consumption or a first origin.

events.caveats: The sampled objects come from burials, not direct observations of ordinary meals; the identification is an archaeological interpretation and does not establish the origin or transmission route of fermentation.

earliest_record.rationale: Date of this scoped case, not a claim of global first.

measures.conditions: Number of ancient cheese remains in this particular 2024 study; not population adoption or production volume.
